overview_description.description:
Avvo is an online legal marketplace connecting consumers and lawyers. The lawyer directory provides Avvo-rated profiles, client reviews, and peer endorsements for 97% of all lawyers in the U.S., so consumers can find the lawyer who’s right for the needs. Avvo also helps lawyers grow businesses with marketing tools and services including Avvo Ignite, a cloud-based marketing platform designed specifically for attorneys.

Avvo was launched in 2007 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

about_short_description.short_description: Avvo is a legal marketplace, directory, and question and answer forum that connects individuals with lawyers.

product.name: Avvo Lawyer Directory
product.description: An online directory that allows users to search and browse profiles of over 1.1 million lawyers by practice area and location.

product.name: Avvo Rating
product.description: A proprietary algorithm that assigns a 1-10 score to lawyers based on their background, experience, and disciplinary records.

product.name: Avvo Client Reviews
product.description: A collection of candid feedback from former clients about lawyers’ communication, professionalism, and personality.

product.name: Avvo Q&A Forum
product.description: An online platform where users can post legal questions anonymously and receive answers from lawyers across the country.

product.name: Avvo Online Consultation Booking
product.description: A service enabling users to book consultations with attorneys directly through the Avvo platform.

product.name: Avvo Premium Concierge Service
product.description: A free service where users can chat with a live agent to get connected with an attorney suited to their legal needs.
